data.name: Velocade
data.detailed_description:
Velocade is a fast-paced, party-style vehicular combat game built for chaos, competition, and big laughs with friends. Choose your car, load up, and throw yourself into explosive arenas filled with moving platforms, crumbling surfaces, and deadly traps.

A Mode for Every Kind of Mayhem

Velocade isn't just one game — it's a whole party. Take on your friends across a growing roster of game modes:

  • Deathmatch — Last car standing wins. Simple. Brutal. Beautiful.

  • Team Battle — Coordinate with your crew to wipe out the opposition.

  • Sumo — Push everyone else off the platform without falling yourself.

  • Solo Challenge — Race through punishing platforms and reach the top in the shortest time.

  • …and more modes on the way.

It's a Party on Wheels

Velocade is designed to be picked up and played with anyone — from hardcore gamers to total newcomers. Jump in, cause chaos, and have a blast. Every match is loud, unpredictable, and over way too fast.

Build Your Crew

Form your own crew with friends, set up your shared Crew Garage, and make it your home base. Customize every corner of your personal garage and your crew's space — your style, your rules.

Build Your Perfect Machine

Personalize your car with a wide range of colors, decals, and body configurations. Whether you prefer a sleek muscle car or a bruising battle rig, make it yours.

Create & Share Your Own Arenas

Got a twisted idea for a level? Build it. Velocade features a built-in Level Editor that lets you design your own arenas and share them with the community. With mod support on the way, the possibilities are only going to grow.

Dynamic Arenas

Navigate arenas packed with moving platforms, invisible hazards, and breakable sections that keep every match unpredictable. Mastering the map is just as important as mastering your opponents.

Key Features

  • Up to 10 players in online multiplayer

  • Multiple game modes: Deathmatch, Team Battle, Sumo, Solo Challenge & more

  • Crew system with shared and personal customizable garages

  • Deep car customization — colors, decals, body styles

  • Built-in Level Editor — create and share your own arenas

  • Mod support coming soon

  • Dynamic hazard-filled arenas

  • Cross-platform multiplayer (coming soon: PS5 & Xbox)

data.short_description: Rev up, ram hard, and be the last one standing. Velocade is a chaotic party vehicular combat game where up to 10 players battle across wild, dynamic arenas. Customize your car and garage, form your crew, and dominate every mode.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Danish, Dutch, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Hungarian, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese, Czech, Indonesian, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8300H or AMD Ryzen 5 3550H
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9750H or AMD Ryzen 7 4800H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 (7-core GPU)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 15.0 Sequoia
  • Processor: Apple M4 Pro
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M4 Pro (20-core GPU)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
